operational_simulations.process: PPE compliance observation at shared industrial and logistics access points
scenarios: normal shift entry with expected PPE
occluded or task-specific equipment and ambiguous scene
peak shift change with crowding, glare and camera degradation
operational_simulations.deterministic_baseline: access rules, task-specific PPE matrix, physical inspection, signage, supervisor checks and incident reporting

operational_simulations.process: unsafe-zone intrusion and proximity review in shared facilities
scenarios: temporary maintenance changing the safe zone
peak operation with vehicles, workers and partial visibility
operational_simulations.deterministic_baseline: barriers, geofenced access, permits, spotters, alarms, speed limits and human observation

operational_simulations.process: ergonomic posture and repetitive-motion screening for prevention programs
scenarios: high-throughput period with changed pace and workstation configuration
operational_simulations.deterministic_baseline: participatory ergonomic assessment, task sampling, checklists, workstation measurements and specialist review

training_data.observation_unit: task-scoped image or video interval captured before a safety review or alert
training_data.input_data: camera frames, site and zone configuration, task type, PPE requirement matrix, access state and environmental conditions available at inference time
training_data.target_or_reward: reviewed presence and correct use of required PPE, unsafe-zone event or posture/action category; incident prevention is not assumed as a directly learnable label
training_data.label_source: specialist-reviewed samples, supervisor corrections and confirmed safety observations collected prospectively
training_data.prediction_time: during access, task execution or planned ergonomic observation before supervisor intervention
training_data.expected_volume: unknown; must be measured per site, camera, task and positive-event type
training_data.class_balance: unknown; true violations and dangerous events are expected to be rare relative to compliant activity
training_data.historical_coverage: unknown; existing CCTV generally lacks task-scoped labels, consent boundaries and representative reviewed exceptions
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based and site-held-out validation with camera, lighting, task, PPE and worker-context holdouts
training_data.leakage_risks: using post-alert supervisor actions, incident records, access denial outcomes or manually zoomed footage unavailable at live inference
training_data.representativeness_risks: occlusion, lighting, camera angle, body diversity, uniforms, PPE variants, task changes, temporary zones and site-specific operating practices
training_data.feedback_loop: specialist confirmation, false-alert dismissal, missed-event review and periodic site-specific recalibration
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: worker monitoring requires purpose limitation, minimization, access controls, retention limits, labor consultation and prohibition of biometric identity inference unless separately lawful and necessary
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: physical barriers, access rules, task-specific PPE checklists, spotters, supervisor inspection, participatory ergonomics and manual incident review

portfolio_comparison.reason: PPE and unsafe-action computer vision are established solution categories, while the residual cross-industry value depends on task-specific configuration, representative site data and safety governance rather than a materially new actor-process-decision architecture
